subject: Draft: Joint Evaluation Playbook + Week0 Roadmap
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nolan <claire@clearstream.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Joint Evaluation Playbook + Week0 Roadmap

Hi Claire — thanks for the sync today. Attached is a first-pass playbook doc (link below) that sketches the evaluation sprint, week0 onboarding checklist, and proposed stakeholder cadence. Primary asks:

- Can you confirm the two engineers who will join the technical deep-dive (suggested: Elena + Marco)?
- Is ClearStream able to provide a short SSO/SCIM requirements doc before our security review next Tuesday?
- Tight timeline: we’re proposing week0 (onboarding + smoke tests) the week of May 25. Does that align with your calendar?

What’s included in the draft:
- Executive objectives + success metrics (time to prod, latency targets)
- Week0 checklist (accounts, VPC peering, test corpus, perf owners)
- 21-day evaluation milestones and acceptance gates
- Risk/mitigation notes (data handling, PII redaction)

Drive link (draft): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EXAMPLEstub-joint-eval
Attachments (stubs): joint-eval-playbook-draft.gdoc, week0-checklist.xlsx, sow-statement-of-work.docx

If that works I’ll make Jasmine the doc owner for edits and Ben will pick up ops-run items. Planning to iterate in the shared doc tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear sections. A couple quick notes: 

1) Engineers: Elena Ruiz (elena@clearstream.com) and Marco Liu (marco@clearstream.com) are confirmed; I’ve looped ops for calendar invites.
2) Security: we can share a short SSO/SCIM snapshot — ops@clearstream.com will send that by EOD Tuesday.
3) Week0 timing: May 25 works but our product PM asked to shift the technical deep-dive to May 27 (internal conflict). Can you accommodate the 27th?

I’ll add inline comments directly in the doc for acceptance criteria and one minor ask on the data retention row.

Claire Nolan
Head of Platform Integrations | ClearStream
claire@clearstream.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Claire Nolan <claire@clearstream.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Joint Evaluation Playbook + Week0 Roadmap

Claire / Marcus — I reviewed the draft and left a few inline suggestions in the doc. High-level proposed edits below: 

- Week0 checklist: split into "Accounts & Access" (accounts, SSO, service accounts) and "Environment Prep" (sample dataset, VPC peering, test harness).
- Add a short runbook for smoke test failures (owner: ClearStream infra).
- Acceptance criteria: make token-level latency and 95th-percentile cost-per-token explicit (we’ll provide baseline numbers in the evaluation metrics table).
- Security deliverables: request for SCIM provisioning sample and a contact for an in-person SOC2 artifact review if needed.

Ben — can you confirm who will own load/perf tests on Redwood side and whether we can schedule a 60-min perf baseline run during week0?

I’ll make myself the editor on the Playbook doc and move the Week0 checklist into a single sheet for tracking owners and dates.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com

Tight but doable — I’ll own the perf/load tests. Proposed schedule:

- May 25: environment provisioning (accounts, VPC, test corpus ingest) — Redwood infra + ClearStream ops
- May 27: technical deep-dive & baseline perf run (60 mins) — Elena, Marco + Redwood infra
- May 28: smoke test window and results review; any critical issues triaged same day

I uploaded a starter slide deck for the May 27 deep-dive (attachment stub: deep-dive-starter.gslides). Marcus / Jasmine — I’ll add suggested test scripts to the shared sheet by EOD tomorrow.
